cases.title: Panel: Show me again explains the change already made with a frame, and makes no second demonstration

rubric.reason: Turn 5 ran preview_frame, changed nothing, and explained the one change without values ("I moved Tab's pivot from its center to the middle of its left edge", with "Tab's edges still read the same" backed by layer_bounds), then handed back with "Now Door's yours: say done when its pivot is on the left edge."

Every name and place used (Door, Tab, Anchor Point, Position, center, middle of the left edge) matches the snapshot and anchor_demo results, such as place_now "center" and place "middle-left", and no invented layer or time appears.

Turn 4 stacks two stages in one turn, the demo report ("Both numbers changed, and Tab didn't move...") and then a full hand walk-through ("I did that with a script, so here's how it goes by hand. Select Door and press A, then Shift+P... Press Y for Pan Behind..."), rather than moving one idea.
